# Full edition licenses

Full contains the pinned llama.cpp Android runtime and Android NDK shared C++
runtime. It downloads Hy-MT2 Q4 weights directly from the immutable upstream
revision documented in `models/HY-MT2-1.8B-GGUF.md`.

- `llama.cpp-caa596ab3/LICENSE.txt` is the exact upstream MIT license.
- `llama.cpp-caa596ab3/KLEIDIAI_NOTICE.txt` preserves the Arm KleidiAI
  copyright and MIT notice for the enabled CPU kernels.
- `ANDROID-NDK-r29-NOTICE.txt` is copied from NDK `29.0.14206865`.
- `models/HY-MT2-1.8B-GGUF-LICENSE.txt` is copied from the exact model
  revision.
